newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends slightly up on NYMEX, Brent gains.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends slightly up on NYMEX, Brent gains.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed slightly higher on the back of moderate gains in Brent, but dealers said it had been a fairly quiet trading day.
April IPE ended 25 cents higher at $162.25 a tonne, having hit a high of $163.75 and a low of $160.75 during the session.
"It was a fairly uneventful session," one trader said.
Many traders said the outlook for both IPE contracts was looking slightly brighter after the gains on NYMEX, but said the market remained nervous after the falls seen in the middle week of the week.
May IPE Brent was trading five cents higher at $18.23 a barrel at 1654 GMT. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
